case_number: 2025 INSC 21; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 4359 OF 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Crl.) No.12606/2023)
summary: Proclaimed offender status post-acquittal; Section 82 Cr.P.C. proclamation validity after acquittal; subsistence of proclamation necessary for Section 174A IPC proceedings; acquittal in NI Act case; absconding not conclusive of guilt; proclamation purpose limited to securing attendance; PO status cannot persist post-acquittal; impugned order refusing quashment set aside.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court order refusing quashment set aside; proclaimed offender status quashed post-acquittal.
